QuestInfo.name: A Call from Pappy
QuestInfo.0: As you prepare to head back to the hideout, someone contacts you on the radio. Better see what this is about.
QuestInfo.1: Pappy called on the radio. His trading partner, #bCorbo,#k has a problem. You should hurry to the #b#m940201000##k.
QuestInfo.2: Corbo is surrounded by a bunch of tough-looking guys. What's going on here?

0.msg: The radio again? I wonder what it is this time...\r\n

1.msg: Are you still out? There's something I need help with and it needs to be taken care of right now.\r\n

0.msg: Our trading partner Corbo sent a signal indicating something's wrong. I don't have any details, but with the boss away... We need to move on this right now.\r\n

1.msg: Get to the #bBrawl 'n' Bash Club#k and don't let anyone hurt #bCorbo#k. I'm worried they might've been abducted. I'll be there with the rest of the crew as soon as I can.\r\n

1.0: You made it. Look, I don't know what to tell you; it's really bad. I think it's those guys I talked about before, the ones pretending to be Shadowdealers...\r\n

0.msg: They keep saying I owe money, but I don't! I keep impeccable books!\r\n

1.msg: But they just kept threatening me. They sent some big scary guys around...\r\n

2.msg: They're the type that use brawn, because it's all they've got. Know what I'm saying? So, maybe you can get through to them.

default.0: Get to the #bBrawl 'n' Bash Club#k and don't let anyone hurt #bCorbo#k. I'm worried they might've been abducted. I'll be there with the rest of the crew as soon as I can.\r\n
